name: Cerbego
look: a huge lion-like fire dog with a mane of flames, flame horns, a roaring fanged mouth and two translucent purple phantom heads flaring beside its own, purple wisps drifting over its back
entry: It guards the way to the land of the dead. The souls it has turned back burn beside it as purple ghost-fire, and in battle they flare up as two more heads.
how: Evolve Blaxer at level 36. It learns Infernal Parade when it evolves.
